name: L G Balakrishnan & Bros Ltd
about: L.G. Balakrishnan & Bros Ltd is a major manufacturer of chains, sprockets and metal formed parts for automotive applications. Its business segments include transmission, metal forming and others.[1]
keyPoints:
Product Segments Q2 FY25
1) Transmission (79%): [1] The company offers chains, sprockets, tensioners, belts and brake shoes.

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 20.6%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 10.8% over past five years.
